sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; it returned a unified SIGIR current-window table and ranked Tool-Star first.
Read SIGIR program evidence, ACM DOI metadata, arXiv abstract and HTML full text, plus the official GitHub README for training and evaluation details.
Mapped Tool-Star's data synthesis, cold-start SFT, GRPO/self-critic DPO loop, six-tool design, reward structure, and inference-time controls into formulas, tables, pseudocode, and Mermaid.
Marked boundaries around SIGIR-vs-arXiv version drift, tool API dependence, Qwen2.5 small-model scope, automatic judging, and lack of full production-agent safety guarantees.
Wrote pure Markdown with self-contained TL;DR, short sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid diagrams, result interpretation, and agent-safety extensions.
